question: A cyclist has to cover a distance of 80 km. After cycling for 4 hours and 48 minutes, he finds that he has completed (4)/(5) th of the total distance. What is his speed in km/h?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Distance covered = 80 × (4/5) = 64 km.

Time = 4 hrs 48 mins = 4 + (48 ÷ 60) = 24/5 hours.

Speed = Distance ÷ Time = 64 × (5/24) = 40/3 = 13.33 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 13.33 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Distance = 80 km

Time taken = 4 hours 48 minutes

Fraction of distance completed = 4/5

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance covered = 80 × (4/5) = 64 km

⇒ Time taken in hours = 4 + (48 ÷ 60)

⇒ Time taken = 4 + 4/5 = 24/5 hours

⇒ Speed = 64 ÷ (24/5)

⇒ Speed = 64 × (5/24)

⇒ Speed = 40/3 = 13.33 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 13.33 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If equal distances are covered at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Relative Speed

If two objects move in opposite directions, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂. If moving in the same direction, Relative Speed = |S₁ − S₂|.
